title: AXI4 Read: Address, Data, Response, and Backpressure
description: Trace an AR request into three R beats, including a stalled middle beat whose RID, RDATA, RRESP, and RLAST remain stable until the master accepts it.

annotations.message: ARVALID offers ID 5, address 0x200, and a three-beat burst. ARREADY is LOW, so all AR payload signals must remain stable.
The AR handshake accepts the read request. Only after this accepting edge may the slave provide R data for this transaction.
The first R beat transfers with RID=5 and RRESP=OKAY. A read response accompanies every accepted data beat.
The slave offers D1, but the master deasserts RREADY. No beat transfers; the slave must hold RID, RDATA, RRESP, RLAST, and RVALID stable.
Backpressure continues and D1 remains unchanged. The AR channel is already free to accept unrelated read addresses.
RREADY returns HIGH and accepts D1 as the second beat.
The final beat transfers with RLAST=1 and RRESP=SLVERR. The error describes this beat; the burst still completes all ARLEN+1 beats.
